text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Now that I've turned in the 
papers to the Chairwoman, all that's left 
is heading back to the inn, but—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
We took the trouble of coming all the way 
outside. We still have time, so why don't 
we wander around a bit before heading 
back?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"As ryokan staff, one must never forget 
rest for the sake of recuperation"—right♪ 
Takeko-san, is there anywhere in 
particular catching your interest?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
There's a spa I've been meaning to check 
out. I was hoping to go there with you.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Apparently you can take a nice, long soak 
in the hot springs, lounge lazily on 
cushions, or quietly enjoy some 
drinks—whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, how wonderful. It sounds like I'll be 
able to relax to my heart's content♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
How about visiting a shrine after that, 
then? Apparently, the shrine down by the 
station offers prayers for prosperous 
business♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a market along the 
tree-lined avenue leading to the shrine. 
Would you like to stop by on our way back?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. ...Oh, isn't that a fancy 
cake shop nearby? Looks like there's an 
Italian place upstairs. Shall we eat here?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Sounds wonderful. The hot spring town's 
jumbo cream puffs and giant parfaits are 
amazing, but this kind of direction is 
quite nice too♪

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
And maybe pick up some inspiration for a 
new menu item while you're at it? You sure 
are shrewd, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Having fun always comes first, okay~? Let 
your hair down, go all out, and recharge 
your energy for tomorrow! âª

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us enjoy it to our heart's 
content.
